Water Contact Advisory Issued for Section of Trahon Creek

Posted: September 02, 2026

The Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality is issuing a water contact advisory for an unnamed tributary of Trahon Creek along its path to the Pearl River due to an ongoing sewage bypass.

The advisory covers the unnamed tributary and Trahon Creek from the culvert at the Interstate 55 frontage road (32.194572 N, 90.250330 W) to its confluence with the Pearl River. (See attached map.) 

 The longstanding water contact advisory for the section of the Pearl River from Hanging Moss Creek to the Byram Swinging bridge remains in effect.

MDEQ recommends that people avoid water contact recreational activities such as swimming, wading and fishing in these waters. MDEQ will monitor conditions and revise the advisory as needed.
